content: Two-sided service marketplace table stakes (Sharetribe, Stripe, Leeonex): accounts/profiles, listings/service catalog, search+filter, booking/availability with states, messaging, reviews (double-sided/blind), secure payments, admin tools, trust mechanisms (verification, badges). MVP should be one constrained demand path to one constrained supply path, operated by humans (concierge) if needed. 9 booking states: requested/accepted/declined/expired/paid/in-progress/completed/cancelled-by-each-side. Avoid: multi-vendor carts, advanced search/ranking/recs, in-app chat before first 50 bookings, recommendation engines.
